claim: Trooping the Colour (The King's Birthday Parade) takes place Saturday 13 June 2026 at Horse Guards Parade, starting 10:30am and finishing by 12:25pm, with Colonel's Review rehearsal on 6 June 2026.
quote: The King's Birthday Parade will take place on Saturday 13th June 2026 at Horse Guards Parade in London.

claim: The Royal Academy Summer Exhibition 2026 runs 16 June to 23 August at Burlington House, the world's largest open-submission contemporary art show.
The London Festival of Architecture runs 1–30 June 2026 with over 400 events across 11 city hubs on the theme of 'Belonging', opening with the Murray Lecture by Jayden Ali.
quote: The London Festival of Architecture (LFA) is back for a month long celebration of architecture and city-making in June 2026 ... theme of 'Belonging'.

claim: Harry Styles curates the Southbank Centre's Meltdown festival from 11–21 June 2026, part of the Centre's 75th anniversary year, with Styles also playing a headline concert.
quote: Harry Styles curates 2026’s Meltdown – the longest-running artist-curated music festival in the world – at London’s Southbank Centre. The festival will span the 11-acre site from 11-21 June 2026

claim: Royal Ascot 2026 runs Tuesday 16 June to Saturday 20 June with 35 races across five days, a central fixture in London's summer social calendar.
quote: The dates for Royal Ascot 2026 are Tuesday 16 June to Saturday 20 June 2026.

claim: Wimbledon 2026 main draw runs 29 June–12 July, with qualifying 22–25 June at the Wimbledon Qualifying and Community Sports Centre.
quote: The 2026 Wimbledon Championships will take place from 29 June to 12 July 2026 at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club

claim: Pride in London 2026 takes place Saturday 4 July with the parade route from Hyde Park Corner via Piccadilly, Regent Street and Oxford Street to Whitehall, with a main stage at Trafalgar Square — just past the June window but the run-up week falls in late June.
Taste of London 2026 runs 17–21 June in Regent's Park across eight sessions, featuring 36 restaurants, 50 chefs and 150 artisan producers.
quote: Taste of London 2026 will be held from Wednesday 17 June to Sunday 21 June at The Regent's Park.

claim: London Open Gardens (formerly Open Garden Squares Weekend) opens 120+ usually-private gardens across 12 boroughs on Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 June 2026 for a single £5 ticket.
quote: London Open Gardens ... Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 June 2026 ... more than 120 secret or usually closed gardens across 12 London boroughs

claim: Lord's hosts an England v New Zealand Rothesay Test from Thursday 4 to Monday 8 June 2026, plus England Women v West Indies in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup on 24 June.
quote: England Men will play New Zealand in a Rothesay Test Match from Thursday 4 June to Monday 8 June, 2026

claim: Tate Modern's blockbuster 'Frida: The Making of an Icon' opens 25 June 2026 (runs to 3 January 2027) with over 130 works exploring Kahlo's self-mythology alongside contemporaries Kiki Smith, Judy Chicago and Ana Mendieta.
quote: Frida: The Making of an Icon, 25 June 2026 – 3 January 2027 ... more than 130 works including treasured garments, jewellery, personal memorabilia and self-portraits

claim: SXSW London 2026 takes over the city 1–6 June with more than 800 speakers, 200 music performances and 100 film screenings, alongside the second-edition Lido festival featuring CMAT and Maribou State.
quote: the second edition of Lido festival (featuring CMAT and Maribou State), the return of SXSW London, and blockbuster exhibitions on Anish Kapoor and Frida Kahlo

claim: Greenwich+Docklands International Festival 2026 falls outside June, running 22 August – 6 September, so visitors in June need not plan around it.
quote: Greenwich+Docklands International Festival 2026 runs from 22nd August – 6th September
